faqs.q: Which anime should a beginner watch first?
faqs.a: Short, self-contained series such as Death Note and Cowboy Bebop are good first picks, because they tell a complete story without hundreds of episodes. Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood is another popular starting point if you want a longer series with a satisfying, complete ending.

faqs.q: Has the Attack on Titan anime finished?
faqs.a: Yes. The Attack on Titan anime has concluded, with its final episodes, released as The Final Chapters, finishing the story in 2023 in line with the manga's ending. You can now watch the whole series from start to finish without waiting for new episodes.

faqs.q: Can I watch Naruto Shippuden without watching Naruto?
faqs.a: You can, but it is better to watch the original Naruto first, because Shippuden continues directly from it and assumes you already know the characters and their history. To save time, many fans skip the filler episodes in both series, which are not based on the manga.
